The Sun
is the most loved object in the solar system and is one of our main sources of our life.
But what would happen if in all of sudden the sun disappears?
What would happen to us?
The first thing that's going to happen when the sun dissapears, we wouldn't notice that for about 8 minutes.
Because that is how long the sunlight reaches the earth.
After that 8 minutes, our sky will turn so dark and would only receive light from the galaxy.
In the first week, the earth's temperature will drop from 0 to -17 degree celsius.
and  -73 to -100 degree celsius within a year. As a result from the situation,
the sea surface will be frozen and illegal fisherman will lose their source of living.
Another good news, finally Indonesians will get to experience snow in their backyard.
The bad news is, electric fan might experience a drastic change in sales.
And with no sunlight, plants will die in a few weeks because of their inability to practice photosynthesis.
Animals will die because their sources of living (the plants) are gone too.
Also the extreme temperature reduces chance of surviving.
Because of that, it is predicted that only microorganisms would survive in this kind of extreme condition.
While humans may live under the sea. Taking advantage from the heat of the earth's core or staying in a shelter with heat energy.
Although we hate the sun most of the time because we don't want our skin to get even tanner, now we realize how important the sun is to us.
